title: Normalize magazine kind filter and pin chip kinds to API contract

spec.problem: Visiting /vi/magazine?kind=bjt (the legacy BJT filter URL) passes raw kind=bjt directly to GET /api/magazine?kind=bjt, where listMagazineHandler (apps/api-go/internal/httpserver/handler_career_content_gamification_misc.go) expects kind=bjt_phrase (mapping to widget_kind magazine_bjt_phrase) and falls through to default widget_kind='bjt', returning 0 articles. MagazinePageClient also does not normalize legacy/widgetKind aliases for active-chip matching or pagination URLs, emits a trailing '?' when resetting to All, and has no regression test pinning its filter chip values to the Go API kind set {vocab, weather, horoscope, loto, bjt_phrase}.

acceptance.text: AC1: /vi/magazine BJT filter chip sends kind=bjt_phrase with user-visible label 'BJT' unchanged, and every non-all chip key matches the Go API listMagazineHandler kind set {vocab, weather, horoscope, loto, bjt_phrase} with documented provenance.

AC2: Direct visits to legacy /vi/magazine?kind=bjt (and widgetKind aliases such as magazine_bjt_phrase, magazine_loto6) normalize at the web layer to canonical API kinds for API fetching, active chip highlighting, retry links, and pagination hrefs.
AC3: Regression tests in page.test.tsx and magazine-page-client.test.tsx pin the API kind set and legacy ?kind=bjt normalization; pnpm quality verify passes; WEB-438 closes VERIFIED via harness.

spec.expected_behavior: MagazinePage normalizes kind via shared normalizeMagazineKind (mapping bjt and magazine_bjt_phrase -> bjt_phrase, plus magazine_vocab/weather/horoscope/loto/loto6/loto7 -> canonical API kinds) before calling GET /api/magazine, building retryHref, and passing kind to MagazinePageClient. MagazinePageClient types all filter chip keys against the canonical API kind set {vocab, weather, horoscope, loto, bjt_phrase} (keeping label 'BJT'), normalizes active-chip matching, pagination hrefs, and metadata lookups, and omits stray trailing '?' on All. Regression tests pin both filter chip values and legacy ?kind=bjt resolution.
spec.observed_behavior: apps/web/app/[locale]/magazine/page.tsx reads sp.kind ?? 'all' without normalization, sending GET /api/magazine?kind=bjt&page=1&limit=12 and rendering empty catalog state ('Chưa có bài viết nào') on /vi/magazine?kind=bjt; MagazinePageClient leaves the BJT chip inactive and emits ?kind=bjt pagination links when given kind='bjt', and no test pins filter chip keys against the API kind set.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert apps/web/app/[locale]/magazine/{magazine-kinds.ts,page.tsx,page.test.tsx,_components/magazine-page-client.tsx,_components/magazine-page-client.test.tsx}; no API, DB, admin, or deploy files are modified.

classification.rationale: Web-layer magazine filter kind normalization, pagination/chip URL handling, and API query contract alignment in apps/web/app/[locale]/magazine; no Go API or database changes.
